en_US: In the Great Marsh, Quick Trams on
rails are used for transportation.
They prevent damage to the Great
Marsh’s ecosystem.
Though the name says “Quick,” their
movements are anything but!
They’re the Quick Trams that traverse
the Great Marsh.
Ah, heavens!
A Trainer has come to visit!
Young Trainer, would you be willing
to listen to my tale?
You should listen to your elders!
You don’t know what you’re missing!
Splendid!
As you can likely see from my clothing
and demeanor, I come from a wealthy
background.
I was fortunate to be born into a
wealthy family, and enjoyed a wide
range of experiences as a result.
One thing that I especially enjoyed
as a young girl was Surfing.
I was gifted a darling LAPRAS by
my father, and we were able to
take to the seas as we pleased.
There’s no sad end to this tale, but
at my age, I cannot continue such
activities, fun as they are.
However, LAPRAS love to cross the sea
with people and Pokémon on its back.
Which brings me to my point, and the
reason for telling you this tale...
Could I entrust my LAPRAS to you,
so it can cross the seas once more?
Oh, goodness...
Was telling that tale a waste?
Oh, goodness...
You have too many Pokémon.
Oh, goodness...
That’s a relief. Thank you.
{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} accepted the LAPRAS!
Would you like to give a nickname
to the LAPRAS you received?
I do miss Surfing the seas...
It was very exhilarating.
Please take good care of LAPRAS.
